objective: Evaluate whether a small 1.6B vision-language model can work against a full PDF book's worth of content while only ever seeing a ~4000-token text window at a time. Test genuine instruction learning on a novel command grammar (UNFOLD, GROUP) rather than transfer of existing protocol conventions.
search_targets: multi-turn context accumulation without vision overhead
must_not_optimize_away: plain text cost accounting (no vision tokens)
promotion_destination: Tlaloc fold-bench reference suite; no external promotion intended.
